summary.understatedFinding: Finding-1: collectYield() Missing Access Control incorrectly sanitized

severityAudits.title: collectYield() Missing Access Control

analysis.assetRisk: Direct yield theft - fees transferred to msg.sender without access control
analysis.attackPath: Valid - any address calls collectYield(), receives all accumulated V4 pool trading fees
analysis.conditions: None required - exploitable by any external address
analysis.impact: Complete theft of all accumulated protocol yield/trading fees

severityAudits.disagreementReason: Trust assumption applies to owner/client actions, NOT to functions without access control. collectYield() has NO modifier - any address can call and steal all fees. This is missing access control, not a trust assumption.
severityAudits.recommendation: REINSTATE as HIGH. Add onlyOwner or onlyAuthorizedWithdrawer modifier to collectYield().

severityAudits.title: withdraw() Uses Recipient Balance

analysis.assetRisk: None - tokens always flow to recipient address, not to caller
analysis.attackPath: Invalid - attacker cannot profit, funds go to victim
analysis.impact: None - this is intentional custodial intermediary pattern
analysis.designPattern: Custodial intermediary: authorized client deposits/withdraws ON BEHALF OF recipient. Tokens always go to/from recipient.

severityAudits.recommendation: Removal is CORRECT. Design is intentional for custodial pattern.

severityAudits.title: _estimateTotalValue() Inaccurate 2x Multiplier

analysis.attackPath: No direct attack path - inaccuracy affects all depositors proportionally
analysis.conditions: Price movement outside configured tick range for concentrated liquidity
analysis.impact: Value redistribution between depositors, orphaned funds possible during migration

severityAudits.recommendation: Keep as Medium. Accounting issue but not exploitable for targeted theft.

severityAudits.title: Two-Phase Withdrawal Balance Caching

analysis.assetRisk: Operational issues during emergency migration, not theft
analysis.attackPath: None - requires owner to initiate totalWithdrawal()
analysis.conditions: Balance change during 24-hour waiting period (yield accrual or surplus withdrawal)
analysis.impact: Orphaned funds if balance increases, failed execution if balance decreases

severityAudits.recommendation: Keep as Medium. Operational/accounting issue, not a theft vector.

severityAudits.title: First Depositor Inflation Attack

analysis.assetRisk: External autopool vault responsibility, not this strategy
analysis.attackPath: N/A for this contract - strategy uses principal tracking, not share system
analysis.impact: N/A - clientBalances tracks deposit amounts, not shares
analysis.reasoning: Strategy wraps external ERC4626 vault. Share inflation would be in underlying vault. Strategy tracks principal deposits independently.

severityAudits.recommendation: Removal is CORRECT. This is the underlying vault's concern, not the strategy's.

c4SeverityCriteria.high: Assets can be stolen/lost/compromised directly or via valid attack path without hypotheticals
c4SeverityCriteria.medium: Assets not at direct risk, but protocol function/availability impacted, or value leak with stated assumptions and external requirements
c4SeverityCriteria.low: State handling issues, spec deviations, centralization risks
